name: DividedLattice.reduceAt_conj_eq_one
summary: Entrywise: j − 1 is divisible by ϖ², so the entries of ϖ⁻¹(γ⁻¹jγ − 1) are sums of products of entries of ϖγ⁻¹, of ϖ̄⁻¹ϖ⁻²(j − 1) and of conjugates of entries of ϖγ⁻¹, all integral, hence it is integral; hence γ⁻¹jγ = 1 + ϖ·(integral) is in K₀ and reduces to 1 at the chosen places.

steps.claim: For k ∈ K₀ reducing to 1 modulo M² and all c, d: ϖ⁻²·(k − 1)_{cd} ∈ Ô (reduction_levelModulus_eq_zero_iff with c = 2, entrywise).
steps.lean:
h⟩ = 1 := have F k (h : O.chosenModulusSq.reductionK₀ k = 1) c d :=
    reduction_levelModulus_eq_zero_iff.1 ((Kf.map_eq_one n).1 h c d)

steps.claim: For all c, d: ϖ̄⁻¹·(ϖ⁻²·(j − 1)_{cd}) ∈ Ô. Place by place: j⁻¹ = jᴴ (j is unitary) also reduces to 1, so ϖ⁻²(j⁻¹ − 1) is integral; its conjugate transpose shows that ϖ̄⁻²(j − 1) is integral. At a place dividing M only ϖ is non-trivial, at a place dividing M̄ only ϖ̄ (M is prime to its conjugate: disjoint_places_star), and elsewhere both are 1 (genIdele_apply_of_notMem).
steps.lean:
have H c d : star O.genIdele⁻¹.1 * (O.genIdele⁻¹ ^ 2 * (j.1.1.1 - 1) c d) ∈ _ :=
    mem_Ô.2 fun w ↦ by
    obtain _ := U.inv_val_eq_conjTranspose j.1,
      star_mem_Ô (mul_mem O.genIntAdele.2 (F j⁻¹ (by simp [t]) d c)), F j t c d
    obtain _ | _ := imp_iff_not_or.1 (@Set.disjoint_left.1 O.chosenModulusSq.disjoint_places_star
      w) <;> simp_all [-F, mem_Ô, places_levelModulus_false, genIdele_apply_of_notMem, sq,
      mul_assoc, v_inv, apply_ite star, @eq_comm n]

steps.claim: For all a, b: ϖ⁻¹·((γ⁻¹jγ) − 1)_{ab} ∈ Ô. Indeed γ⁻¹jγ − 1 = γ⁻¹(j − 1)γ, and its entries are sums of products of (ϖγ⁻¹)_{ac} (integral by L), the integral numbers of step 2, and conjugates of entries of ϖγ⁻¹ (γ = (γ⁻¹)ᴴ, L.integral).
steps.lean:
have G a b : O.genIdele⁻¹ * ((L.γ⁻¹ * j * L.γ).1.1 - 1) a b ∈ Ô E := by
    rw [(by simp [mul_sub, sub_mul] : _ - 1 = L.γ⁻¹.1.1 * (j.1.1.1 - 1) * L.γ.1.1)]
    simpa [mul_apply, sum_mul, mul_sum, sq, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, ← Units.coe_star,
      -Units.coe_star_inv] using sum_mem fun d _ ↦ sum_mem fun c _ ↦ mul_mem (mul_mem
      (L.integral a c) (H c d)) (star_mem_Ô (U.inv_val_eq_conjTranspose L.γ ▸ L.integral b d :))
steps.typed_fact: O.genIdele⁻¹ * ((L.γ⁻¹ * j * L.γ).1.1 - 1) a b ∈ Ô E

steps.claim: Hence γ⁻¹jγ = 1 + ϖ·(integral matrix) lies in K₀ (mem_Kf), and at every chosen place its reduction is 1, since ϖ·x reduces to 0 there (reduction_levelModulus_eq_zero_iff, modulusResidue_reduction).
steps.lean:
⟨mem_Kf.2 (by simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_mem_cancel_right,
    ite_mem] using mul_mem O.genIntAdele.2 <| G · ·), fun i ↦ (Kf.map_eq_one _).2 fun a b ↦ by
    simp [← modulusResidue_reduction (O.levelModulus 1 _) (places_levelModulus_false.ge ⟨i, rfl⟩),
      reduction_levelModulus_eq_zero_iff.2, by simpa using G]⟩
